name: 80-Lot Subdivision
subtitle: Phased Feasibility & Monthly Cash Flow
description: Ground-up subdivision feasibility model built around a $3.7M land basis, $68K finished-lot basis, $150/SF construction budget, and three-lot monthly absorption. The analysis compares phased delivery against a single-phase build to show effects on capital deployment, gross margin, and IRR.
analysis-design-list-2:
• Land basis and finished-lot cost analysis
  • Phased delivery schedule and inventory release plan
  • Construction cost and horizontal improvement assumptions
  • Absorption pace sensitivity and revenue timing
  • Single-phase versus phased-build comparison
financial-deliverables-list-2:
• Monthly cash flow model
  • Lot takedown and absorption schedule
  • Gross margin and IRR outputs
  • Construction cost sensitivity
  • Feasibility summary for investor review

name: 311-Unit Downtown SD Highrise
description: Full highrise development proforma with construction draw schedule, lease-up assumptions, refinance case, disposition case, and JV waterfall logic using a 10% preferred return and 60/40 GP/LP promote split.
analysis-design-list-2:
• Development program and unit mix setup
  • Hard cost, soft cost, and contingency assumptions
  • Construction draw and lease-up timing
  • Refinance versus disposition scenario analysis
  • JV waterfall structure and promote sensitivity
financial-deliverables-list-2:
• Full development proforma
  • Construction draw schedule
  • Refinance and sale scenarios
  • JV waterfall return summary
  • Investor-level cash flow exhibit

name: 280-Unit Condo Conversion

  • Rental conversion proforma

  • Workout recommendation memo
